apps.name: LocalSend
apps.description: Share files and messages to nearby devices over the local network — no internet, no accounts.
apps.author: LocalSend
apps.notes:
This release fixes compatibility issues with 1.17.0 and earlier.
Note: The Windows binaries have been updated to include a signature.

- feat: drag and drop files into the "Receive via link" browser page
- feat(desktop): allow customizing the web share pages by placing HTML files in a `web` folder next to the executable
- feat(cli): add version info to the Windows executable
- feat(linux): set actual version in the AppImage
- security: do not follow HTTP redirects sent by peers
- fix: restore compatibility with 1.17.0 and earlier versions on missing multicast networks
- fix: devices running 1.17.0 and earlier could not add 1.18.0+ device as favorite
- fix: ignore proxies, fixes "TLS info not found" when a system proxy (e.g. Shadowrocket) is enabled
- fix: automatically restart the HTTP / multicast server when it dies or when the app resumes
- fix: drag and drop with a mix of folders and files
- fix: during transfer, add bottom padding when Advanced is open (@Chethan616)
- fix: do not crash at startup when the executable path cannot be resolved (@Shlomo116)
- fix(android): ignore unknown or invalid file modification times when reading files
- i18n: add Armenian

apps.name: draw.io
apps.description: Diagramming app — flowcharts, UML, network and architecture diagrams, fully offline.
apps.author: JGraph
apps.notes:
## Release Notes for 32.3.0

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-universal-32.3.0.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-amd64-32.3.0.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.6.0
- Updates each install type the way it was installed. The Windows installer, macOS and AppImage download updates in the background and show a notice and Help > Restart to Update when one is ready, or install it when you quit. MSI, zip, portable, deb and rpm installs show a notice with a link to the release page instead of running the Windows installer over themselves. Extras > Automatic Updates turns the background checks on and off. Coming from 31.7.0, this update still arrives the previous way [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]
- Prints on the printer's own paper size and orientation on macOS, so landscape pages print in landscape on A4 or Letter [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568]
- Prints pages with a page scale above 100% at full size, they were shrunk a second time since 30.3.11 [jgraph/drawio#5540]
- Adds --embed-svg-metadata to the command line, which adds the properties of shapes and connectors to SVG exports as data-meta-* attributes [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]
- Opens the window with the background of the loading screen, which avoids a white flash in dark mode
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.3.0](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.3.0/ChangeLog). All changes from 31.7.0 to 32.3.0 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape libraries, the export dialog and the print dialog
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered for this build
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 259 unit tests pass

Updates

- A new install reports no pending update, shows Check for Updates in the Help menu and Automatic Updates switched on in the Extras menu
- When the editor is told that an update has been downloaded it shows the restart notice and the Help menu offers Restart to Update instead of Check for Updates, and an available update for installs that do not update themselves shows the download notice
- Clicking the notice while no update is pending leaves the app and the open diagram as they are
- Switching Automatic Updates off and on again survives a restart each way
- The rules for which install type downloads, links to the release page or never checks are covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]

Printing

- The paper sent to the print dialog is the page format in portrait order with landscape set for landscape pages, and pages are printed at 100% for every page scale, covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568] [jgraph/drawio#5540]

Command line

- --embed-svg-metadata adds the properties of a shape as data-meta-* attributes to the SVG, and the same export without the option adds none [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]

Core changes checked in the desktop app

- Exports with a scale and a border have the same border on all four sides from the command line, where the right and bottom border were narrower in 31.7.0, and exports at scale 1 or fitted to a width are unchanged [jgraph/drawio#5559]
- Drafts of unsaved changes are saved as plain diagram data, also for .drawio.svg files, and reopening the file offers the draft and restores the unsaved change
- Tall diagrams and Mermaid files open fitted to the window with every shape in view
- Changes made to an open file by another program are detected while the window is in the background
- The image export dialog shows the new presets
- Mermaid files converted from the command line keep the same layout as in 31.7.0, and an empty Mermaid file still ends with an error instead of writing a file

Checks around the changes

- The window background colour in dark mode matches the editor's background
- The functions the app exposes to the editor page are unchanged and give it no access to Node
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- File and javascript links are still refused rather than opened externally
- Every update manifest names 32.3.0, and the Windows x64 and arm64 manifests each list only their own installer

apps.name: Logseq
apps.description: Local-first outliner and knowledge base over plain markdown with backlinks and graph view.
apps.author: Logseq
apps.notes:
Logseq 2.0.2 Beta brings smoother editing, faster startup, and more reliable everyday workflows to the DB version.

[Join the iOS TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/eBcJ9Hpc), 2.0.2 is currently under App Store review.

Web app: https://app.logseq.com/

## Features

- Gallery cards can now use URL properties as covers.
- Added a "Clear heading" slash command.
- Improved video embeds, with resizable desktop players and clickable YouTube timestamps.

## Thanks

- **Special thanks to our community PR contributors!** Your fixes, performance improvements, translations, and careful reviews helped make this beta better. Contributors include [@yuxi-liu-wired](https://github.com/yuxi-liu-wired), [@ChipNowacek](https://github.com/ChipNowacek), [@Mancn-Xu](https://github.com/Mancn-Xu), [@hahaArthur17](https://github.com/hahaArthur17), [@maksym-dilanian](https://github.com/maksym-dilanian), [@qwist1233-cpu](https://github.com/qwist1233-cpu), and many others.
- **A heartfelt thank-you to everyone testing the DB beta.** Your bug reports, reproduction steps, feedback, and retesting of fixes have been invaluable. Thank you for helping us improve Logseq with your real-world graphs and workflows!

## Fixed issues

Ordered by impact on data integrity, reliability, and everyday workflows.

1. **Preserve unsaved edits:** Save pending text before following page or block references, switching blocks, or setting Deadline/Scheduled. Pasting multiple blocks no longer lets a stale editor buffer erase the first pasted title.
2. **Restore deleted content with undo/redo:** Restore deleted blocks and pages that reference each other, along with property schemas and values. Undoing block moves now preserves their original order and nested structure.
3. **Keep block trees intact when copying or moving:** Selecting an ancestor together with its descendants no longer pulls grandchildren out of their subtree. Copy/paste preserves the original child blocks, and embed actions operate on the embed rather than its source.
4. **Keep graph and asset downloads running:** One failed asset download no longer stops the remaining asset queue or fails the graph download. Sync also keeps property-value replacements together instead of splitting them across requests.
5. **Fix Windows installation:** Fix the NSIS installer crash affecting Windows 11 24H2 and newer, so the desktop app can be installed normally.
6. **Improve file-to-DB import fidelity:** Preserve headings, icons, journal timestamps, and PDF annotation identities/order. Asset links in property values are converted into asset references, and same-title classes and properties remain distinct.
7. **Correct scheduled dates and repeating tasks:** Deadline/Scheduled repeats now advance in the local calendar. Monthly repeats no longer drift permanently after a shorter month; date filters use local days, and clearing dates removes stale journal references.
8. **Prevent query errors from crashing the graph:** Incomplete query syntax, invalid regular expressions, and query-function rendering errors are isolated. Query-builder filters again show property/tag names and include custom Status and Priority choices.
9. **Fix property editing and choice selection:** Selected node values remain visible in property pickers, choice identities resolve consistently, and configuration toggles save the newly selected value. Empty multi-value slots and date values can be cleared without errors.
10. **Restore readable search results and references:** Resolve UUID references in search titles, breadcrumbs, and nested page references. References to deleted nodes remain visible as broken links, and opening search no longer clears its results.
11. **Restore settings and HTML publishing:** Settings can be saved when config.edn is missing or invalid, and the first export.css edit creates the file correctly. HTML exports no longer open as a blank page and honor the configured home page.
12. **Make desktop editing and keyboard input reliable:** Clicks during scrolling now open the editor. A click after Escape or Shift+Up/Down keeps the newly opened editor, and fixes cover international dead-key input and IME confirmation in search.
13. **Fix Android popup and layout issues:** Nested popups reuse the presented native sheet, sheet dismissal avoids re-entry, and the layout respects the status-bar safe area. Mobile cloud-graph download and sync triggers work again.

## Enhancements

- **Faster startup and smoother editing:** Improved desktop startup, journal loading, large-page rendering, table scrolling, and search, with fewer unnecessary updates while typing.
- **Better everyday workflows:** Improved flashcard practice, date and repeating-task handling, international keyboard input, plugin APIs, CLI behavior, and translations.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/compare/2.0.1...2.0.2)
